verdict: Organic presence is softening across all three entities; pipeline work is in motion.
narrative: Across Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals, the last 28 days produced 441 combined Google Business Profile actions — calls, direction requests, and website clicks — with no paid spend active on any channel. GBP engagement declined meaningfully in the most recent 7 days (down 50%, 43%, and 27% respectively versus the prior 7 days), and the last three days across all entities show near-zero activity, which we are treating as a confirmed softening rather than normal fluctuation. CRM data reconciliation and outreach sequencing — both prerequisites for activating the reengagement pipeline — are being completed now, with the full outreach wave and site reindexing targeted for delivery by October 31. Once those are live, the program will have active paid and outreach signals running alongside organic, giving you a materially fuller picture next period.
